* Retrieving a specific card can be reduced from 1 card retrieved to 0.
* Code Clearance stacks an Interrupt after it retrieves Force. By this time, the Interrupt could already have been stacked on another grabber (e.g. [[Allegations Of Corruption]]) first, in which case it remains on that first grabber.
* Code Clearance can stack an Interrupt before [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough{{!}}This Place Can Be A Little Rough]] can place it out of play.
* [[Outrider]] places Utinni Effects out of play before Code Clearance can stack.
* DS cards such as [[You Swindled Me!]] may be stacked.

A full card image with the corrected text and a white E in the lower border, from the Players Committee's Holotable image set (8 July 2018).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Ref3-D-dotheyhaveacodeclearance-PC-Errata-2018-E-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Do They Have A Code Clearance? (Defensive Shield) (PC Errata 2017 slip)]] (31 May 2017): Same words as the previous version. This is a full card image again (350 × 490 pixels), with the white italic “E” in the black lower border. The game text is set in a bolder, narrower typeface than on the slips; the Grabber icon is in the type bar.

The 2017 slip and the same area of the 2018 E card, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
